integrity: An exhaustive finite enumeration of overlap-free binary words through length 14 and of their same-length nearest Hamming neighbors supports the lower bounds and shortest-word classifications. The bundled verifier is a computational finite certificate, not formal or external attestation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the first two generalized levels beyond ordinary delicacy, k=2 and k=3. It does not settle the all-k existence question or give a formula for larger k.
title: Sharp first generalized-delicacy thresholds for binary overlap-free words
